name: hassan-electronics
description: Hassan Electronics ERP + POS monorepo. Four independently-installed apps under apps/: erp-backend (API), erp-frontend (web UI), erp-desktop (Electron installer), erp-mobile (read-only Android). See CLAUDE.md.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/erp-backend install && npm --prefix apps/erp-frontend install && npm --prefix apps/erp-desktop install && npm --prefix apps/erp-mobile install
